about: Settings of the Gemini Task route (GC-20..GC-27, explainer_engine/gemini_task). The one home of the Drive root, the batch defaults and the style pack table (one style anchor per shot type, GC-21). Engineering defaults set by the A2 build (2026-11-12) unless a line names the creator.
drive_root_note: the project's existing Drive folder (the creator, 2026-11-12 15:25 UTC: the Drive folder already exists); a folder name only, never a link
batch_size_note: six pictures per answer (the creator, 2026-11-12 15:20 UTC) until the T0 record sets another number (spec section 6)
max_references_note: attachments of one picture: the tool's limit is not published (spec F10), 6 is ours (GC-02); T0/T1 measure it
max_attachments_note: files attached to one batch message (the union of its pictures' references): not published and not measured (spec F10); 10 is an engineering default until T0/T1 measure it

main_style.role: image 1 of every style anchor, portrait, full body and place (GC-21)

style_pack.about: Image 1 of a scene picture is the style anchor of its shot type (GC-21, spec Q4). An anchor is used only when approved (the creator picks after T0, spec section 6): status 'approved' with its sha256 and the creator's message id. 'match' is tried in this order; the first rule that fits the shot wins; a shot may name its own 'shot_type'.

types.label: special moment: hands and objects, no face
night exterior: moon and one torch
wide view: tiny figures, the place carries the frame
a group of three or more, medium-wide at dusk

reference_sizes.about: Which of a hero's two references a scene picture attaches (Q7): the portrait always (the face), the full body too when the shot shows bodies
